acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Environment-fit report with deterministic replay logs, token/action density measurements, continuation/cloning check, reuse analysis, and leakage/shortcut audit.
acceptance_tests.expected: A selected Level-1 world and the proposed Level-2 target satisfy the declared fit gates: reusable within-life structure exists, held-out action value requires cross-episode evidence, decision-time memory injection is possible, and no target-only/current-state/identifier predictor exceeds its preregistered floor.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The target environment cannot support a developmental, action-first lifetime protocol; it must not be promoted as the primary benchmark.
acceptance_tests.setup: CPU-first inspection of DiscoveryWorld-Lifetimes feasibility and small deterministic candidate controlled worlds; fit criteria and predictor floors are bound before model experiments.

acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Atomic-writer/read-fidelity report: witnessed atoms, reverse/paraphrase/partial-cue reads, exceptions, one supported shortcut, provenance records, and adapter-reset checks.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only eligible lived evidence enters the candidate corpus; the MEMORY adapter is rebuilt from the clean frozen base per life, read fidelity and uncertainty behavior are reported separately from action performance, and no read plan exposes held-out answers.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Observed gains could be caused by malformed installation, leakage, cross-life contamination, or a reader that is not faithful enough to interpret downstream results.
acceptance_tests.setup: CPU tests on varied action-outcome atoms and locally supported procedures, including contradicted and stale cases; no hidden environment truth is model-visible.

acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Deterministic common-deck checkpoint outputs, cleared-context/cache logs, memory snapshots, paired seed statistics, budget ledger, and hidden evaluation-deck disposition records.
acceptance_tests.expected: At each geometric checkpoint, all arms receive exactly the same lived stream, comparable action/thought/retrieval/context/adapter-byte/consolidation-compute budgets, cleared transient state, and a frozen memory snapshot before read-only held-out tasks.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: A claimed representational or consolidation advantage is actually explained by unequal experience, retained working context/cache, evaluation feedback, or unequal resources.
acceptance_tests.setup: Run fixed common-deck attribution at 1C and 2C after the CPU gates; checkpoint evaluations are read-only and their outcomes never re-enter the life.

acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Pre-registered ablation table with per-world-life curves for full system, no memory, context controls, raw and organized external memory, direct/raw LoRA, sleep-text, same-corpus LoRA, shortcut ablations, shuffled controls, cross-life controls, and batch-SFT reference.
acceptance_tests.expected: The full system's effect decomposes into trace selection, dream-local connection growth, compiler/materialization, per-life parametric transport, and goal-conditioned reconstruction; each comparison preserves declared budgets.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Any apparent full-system gain persists under shuffled action-outcome bindings or cross-life adapters, is reproduced by direct/raw trajectory LoRA or external memory, or depends on an omitted resource mismatch.
acceptance_tests.setup: Use whole held-out world-lives as replication units; include strongest feasible native-long-context and linked A-MEM/GraphRAG-style controls, not only weak raw replay.

acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Blinded action-life evaluation package: per-checkpoint A0-A4 action outcomes, provenance-cited paths, prediction-before-outcome logs, calibration/false-memory metrics, correction traces, and offline scoring report.
acceptance_tests.expected: A positive result is limited to improved normalized A2-A4 held-out action value and post-context lifetime AUC under the frozen protocol; exact recall, reader fidelity, dependency reconstruction, query cost, and action benefit are reported separately.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The result is confined to A0/A1 recall or lookup, relies on an answer-bearing graph/verifier, fails under counterfactual twins or rule changes, or false-memory accumulation exceeds correction.
acceptance_tests.setup: Evaluate fresh goals whose exact solution was not in an episode, including one- through four-dependency goals, exceptions, counterfactual twins, and controlled changes; commit before later outcome is visible.

acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: On-policy paired-world report with fixed action budgets, hidden checkpoint branches, cross-system experience-swap matrix, and action-information-gain accounting.
acceptance_tests.expected: If the on-policy flywheel is claimed, better memory causes measurably different information-seeking actions, those public outcomes alter later eligible dream inputs, and the resulting later held-out action gain survives the experience/representation swap decomposition.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The on-policy improvement is entirely due to a better fixed representation of an identical stream, to extra actions, or to evaluation outcomes leaking back into the life.
acceptance_tests.setup: Run only after common-deck attribution and independent review; pair world seeds and hold action budgets fixed.

acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Independent-review packet containing bound protocol, source hashes, code diff, test evidence, budget ledger, held-out split ledger, leakage audit, and every failed/negative result.
acceptance_tests.expected: A fresh reviewer verifies that all pre-GPU gates passed, no forbidden information reached cognition, all declared baselines and falsifiers were executed, and the stated conclusion matches the evidence.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Any unreviewed protocol drift, missing baseline, leakage route, invalid replication unit, or overbroad attribution blocks GPU promotion and headline use.
acceptance_tests.setup: Fresh-context review occurs after implementation/tests and again after any repair; an author-side advocate may respond but cannot override the verdict.

claims.after: The proposed primary behavioral hypothesis is conditional: a fixed pretrained agent may continue improving on held-out A2-A4 actions after lived experience exceeds a disclosed working-context budget if recurrent trace-conditioned dream compilation plus a reset-isolated per-life MEMORY LoRA and goal-conditioned reconstruction outperform matched episodic, linked-text, direct-parametric, and native-long-context controls.
claims.before: Current evidence establishes selected prerequisites and small-scale transport/controlled composition diagnostics, but not a long-horizon developmental action advantage or baseline saturation.
claims.evidence_needed: Pre-registered whole-world-life curves at 0.5C, 1C, 2C, 4C, 8C, and 16C; matched controls; post-context A2-A4 action value/AUC; two later positive checkpoints; independent review.

claims.after: The MEMORY LoRA is credited only as lossy per-life persistence and associative access for compiler-produced semantic/procedural associations and tested hot-path shortcuts; explicit tokens and working state perform multi-hop reconstruction, while the dream resolver/compiler proposes and validates eligible local structure.
claims.before: Existing transport results can show that formatted atomic experiential content is installed and recognized under a specified protocol, but do not establish autonomous structural discovery, complete planning, or LoRA-specific intelligence.
claims.evidence_needed: Same accepted corpus in text and LoRA; reader-fidelity probes; dream-text versus direct replay ablations; atomic versus shortcut ablations; cited reconstruction paths; matched action tests.

claims.after: The developmental prediction explicitly permits early context/RAG superiority and non-monotone learning; the useful-memory threshold is the first checkpoint with a preregistered practical advantage over the strongest matched organized external-memory baseline that remains positive at two later checkpoints.
claims.before: No threshold or crossover has been demonstrated; small-memory context-plus-recognition and LoRA-plus-recognition may be equivalent.
claims.evidence_needed: Lifetime curves beyond C, native-long-context control, causal coverage accounting, threshold analysis, and whole-world-life replication.

claims.after: A later on-policy claim is limited to the complete organism: memory-guided information-seeking actions can improve the later experience distribution and subsequent action only if paired fixed-action and cross-system experience-swap experiments isolate that feedback loop.
claims.before: Controlled L0 experiment-resolution and fixed-corpus/ceiling work show component possibilities, not a general self-improving on-policy lifetime flywheel.
claims.evidence_needed: Paired on-policy lives with fixed action budget, hidden checkpoint evaluations, swap decomposition, provenance logs, and independent review.

claims.after: Negative or null results require narrowing or rejecting the headline: no sustained post-context advantage; identical-deck disappearance; insensitivity to action-outcome or cross-life shuffling; A0/A1-only gains; no sleep-compilation benefit; no matched shortcut cost reduction; no recurrent-over-batch gain; resource confounds; uncontrolled false-memory drift; or target-only shortcut prediction.
claims.before: These falsifiers are proposed but have not been executed for the developmental benchmark.
claims.evidence_needed: Registered falsifier outcomes and unaltered evidence artifacts, including null/negative cells.

summary: Proposal to evaluate developmental experiential learning as a controlled long-horizon organism: lived action/outcome traces feed recurrent dream-time local connection growth and a provenance-preserving compiler; a reset-isolated MEMORY LoRA provides lossy per-life associative persistence; goal-conditioned wake reconstruction composes explicit working paths into later actions. The proposal intentionally leaves the benchmark choice, threshold, budgets, schedule details, and controller-learning inclusion for human ratification.
system_thesis: An agent may become more capable over its own lifetime when it converts public consequences of action into an increasingly connected experiential world approximation: lived episodes preserve exact evidence; dream-time recurrence builds and revises local semantic/procedural connections; compilation transports selected associations into a per-life LoRA; goal-conditioned retrieval plus explicit planning reconstructs useful paths for new actions; later thinking and outcomes become eligible inputs to future dream cycles. Intelligence and behavioral credit belong to the complete temporal organism, not to LoRA alone, dreaming alone, or a static retrieval store.
title: Developmental experiential learning: recurrent dream compilation and per-life parametric memory
